description: Work with your Intralinks data rooms from a workflow: upload, download and organize documents and folders, manage members, groups and phases, read permissions and access reports, and start workflows when documents or people arrive.

intralinks_new_document_trigger.description: Runs for each new document in an Intralinks workspace, or in one of its folders. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.extension: Its file extension, such as pdf.
output.has_note: True when it has a note.
output.id: The document's ID, for 'Get document' or 'Download document'.
output.index_number: Its index number in the workspace, such as 1.1.2.
output.name: The document's name.
output.unread: True while the connected person hasn't opened it.
output.version: Its current version, which changes each time it changes.
output.version_number: How many times its file has been replaced.

parameters.description: The workspace (data room) to watch.
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.description: Only watch this folder. Leave empty to watch every folder in the workspace.
parameters.name: folder_id

intralinks_new_folder_trigger.description: Runs for each new folder in an Intralinks workspace. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.has_subfolders: True when it has folders inside it.
output.index_number: Its index number in the workspace, such as 1.1.
output.name: The folder's name.
output.parent_id: The folder it is in (empty at the top of the workspace).

parameters.description: The workspace (data room) to watch.
parameters.name: workspace_id

intralinks_new_group_trigger.description: Runs for each new group in an Intralinks workspace. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.member_ids: IDs of the members in it.
output.name: The group's name.

parameters.description: The workspace (data room) to watch.
parameters.name: workspace_id

intralinks_new_or_updated_document_trigg.description: Runs for each document added to an Intralinks workspace (or one of its folders), and again each time one changes. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.extension: Its file extension, such as pdf.
output.has_note: True when it has a note.
output.id: The document's ID, for 'Get document' or 'Download document'.
output.index_number: Its index number in the workspace, such as 1.1.2.
output.name: The document's name.
output.unread: True while the connected person hasn't opened it.
output.version: Its current version, which changes each time it changes.
output.version_number: How many times its file has been replaced.

parameters.description: The workspace (data room) to watch.
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.description: Only watch this folder. Leave empty to watch every folder in the workspace.
parameters.name: folder_id

intralinks_new_workspace_trigger.description: Runs for each Intralinks workspace the connected person is given access to. Ones they could already open when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.id: The workspace's ID, for the other Intralinks steps.
output.name: The workspace's name.
output.phase: Its phase: OPEN, PREPARATION or HOLD.
output.template_id: The template it was made from.
output.type: Intralinks' type for it, such as ARC.
output.version: Its version, which goes up each time it changes.

intralinks_new_workspace_user_trigger.description: Runs for each person added to an Intralinks workspace. People already in it when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.first_accessed_at: When they first opened the workspace (ISO 8601).
output.id: The member's ID in this workspace.
output.role: Their role, such as REVIEWER or MANAGER_PLUS.
output.user_id: The person's Intralinks user ID, the same in every workspace.
output.welcome_sent: True once the welcome email has gone out.

parameters.description: The workspace (data room) to watch.
parameters.name: workspace_id

intralinks_workspace_phase_changed_trigg.description: Runs each time one of the connected person's Intralinks workspaces moves to another phase, such as from preparation to open or to on hold. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.id: The workspace's ID, for the other Intralinks steps.
output.name: The workspace's name.
output.phase: Its phase: OPEN, PREPARATION or HOLD.
output.template_id: The template it was made from.
output.type: Intralinks' type for it, such as ARC.
output.version: Its version, which goes up each time it changes.
